outcome: prevalence of mental disorders during pregnancy
finding: Pregnant women diagnosed with mental disorders were more likely to deliver by cesarean section, and infants of women with depression during pregnancy were more likely to be underweight and/or delivered preterm.
mod_finding: Women diagnosed with a mental disorder were more likely to deliver their child by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Infants of women diagnosed with an ICD-10 code for depression during pregnancy were more likely to be underweight
